/journal/working-with-your-interior-desi: Plan zones by frequency of use, so everyday items sit between waist and eye height and occasional ones go higher or lower.
Specify the interior fittings, such as drawer dividers, pull-outs, shelf heights and the ratio of long to double hanging, so the inside of the cabinetry is designed rather than filled.

Home Harmonics works with the trade on post-install organization, move-in completion and client handoff in Dallas–Fort Worth and, by arrangement, on projects elsewhere. /journal/preparing-a-custom-home-for-mov: If the home is large, the move date is fixed, or you are relocating from another city, a move-in concierge takes this planning off your hands. Home Harmonics plans each room before the move, by video when you are relocating, sources the storage to the measurements, unpacks and sets up the house over consecutive days, and leaves a care guide so the system holds once you are living in it. See how Move-In Concierge works.

If you are still in the drawings, it is not too early. Shelf heights, drawer layouts and the balance of long and double hanging are far easier to change on paper than after installation. Read about organizing inside custom cabinetry.
/journal/seasonal-wardrobe-changeover/: For clients whose homes are already organized, Home Harmonics offers spring and autumn wardrobe changeovers as part of Seasonal Resets. Because the system already exists, a changeover is quick: the off-season is cleaned, stored and labeled, the coming season comes forward, and the closet is adjusted as the wardrobe changes. If you are starting from the beginning, Closet & Wardrobe Organization sets up the system first.
